bio:
Text2PDF is a plain text editor that exports a PDF. Files stay in your browser and nothing is sent anywhere, which is the whole reason it exists.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling).
title: Text2PDF by Tront
list:
• Splitter4GPT: Split large text files into chunks that fit into ChatGPT and other language models.
  • Procedural Packed Texture Generator: Generate procedurally packed tiling textures with a live WebGL shader preview.
